In [[mathematics]], an element ''p'' of a [[partial order]] (P, ≤) is a '''meet prime''' element when ''p'' is the principal element of a [[principal ideal|principal]] [[Ideal (order theory)#Prime ideals|prime ideal]]. Equivalently, if ''P'' is a [[lattice (order)|lattice]], ''p'' ≠ ''top'',  and for all ''a'', ''b'' in ''P'', 
:''a''∧''b'' ≤ ''p'' implies ''a'' ≤ ''p'' or ''b'' ≤ ''p''.
